{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies fee estimation logic in src/policy/fees/.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents fee estimation outages by falling back to block policy estimates when mempool policy data is unavailable. As the description notes, estimatesmartfee returned an error instead of available block policy estimates after restarts or upgrades, and failed mempool loads could cause stale mined-block stats to return an incorrect fee floor rate; maintainers noted this split-out fix is needed for 32.x backport."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/fees.cpp to adjust estimatesmartfee argument parsing and error responses.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Clarifies argument naming and tightens RPC validation by replacing 'none' with 'auto' and rejecting unrecognized estimator options. Commit 4056908f0f notes that 'none' implied fee estimation was disabled, and rejecting unknown options prevents mistyped values from silently falling back to defaults."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to tests only accompany fee policy modifications and do not touch test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",

    },
